title: Efficient Multigrid Methods for Semi-implicit Landau-Lifshitz Schemes in Micromagnetic Simulations
summary: An efficient aggregation-based multigrid approach is developed in this work to solve linear algebraic systems generated by discretizing the Landau-Lifshitz equation in micromagnetics. The discretization couples the first-order backward differentiation formula with first-order extrapolation, and the underlying equation describes magnetization dynamics within micromagnetic simulations.
